evidence_level_definitions.official_indexed_text_only: Substantive passages were available through official-domain search extraction, but direct primary-text retrieval was unsuccessful.
evidence_level_definitions.official_supporting_text_only: Official annex/briefing text supports discovery, but the main study was not retrieved.
evidence_level_definitions.official_summary_only: An official substantive summary supports discovery; the underlying full opinion was not retrieved.
evidence_level_definitions.official_catalogue_only: The official catalogue identifies the document; primary contents, credits and exact version remain unverified.

conventions: All candidates are pending; canonical_record_id is null. No inventory disposition, public record or source-family coverage status is changed.
Titles, references, dates and roles are reported evidence, with remaining ambiguities explicit. Relevance, temporal collection and tags are editorial proposals, not official metadata.
Counts refer to distinct document/version candidates, not unique legal instruments, attachments, URLs or languages. EASA Roadmaps 1.0 and 2.0 are separately citable versions.
Document dates and publication dates are distinct. A 2017 resolution republished in the 2018 OJ remains historical. Date precision is retained; unknown days are never replaced with 1 January.
A published workplan may discuss activities after the cutoff. Such future activities are not treated as already completed events.
No local full-text archive or verified file checksum of an official PDF was created. Source text was retrieved through search/open tools.
Historical research programmes are not asserted to be legal predecessors of the AI Act. There is no fixed earliest eligible year.
A query-based first pass cannot establish completeness. No catalogue pagination was exhausted, and inaccessible sources are unresolved rather than presumed empty.
No indirect_adm_legal_context candidate was verified in this pass. This does not mean that subset is empty; known data-protection and automated-decision anchors remain to be audited.
The source cut-off remains 4 September 2026 even though research was performed on 5 September. Exact manifestation availability still requires confirmation where publication_date is null.
